title: A sealed Vehicle interface with record kinds

blocks.text: The page's syntax section seals an interface as well as a class: `public sealed interface Vehicle permits Car, Motorcycle, Truck { }`. In the course's code the three kinds are records, and a record is implicitly `final`, so it already has one of the modifiers a permitted subtype needs.
`Garage` holds the three records and an interface `Vehicle` that anyone could still implement.

items: Seal `Vehicle` so that exactly `Car`, `Motorcycle` and `Truck` may implement it.
Write `static int wheels(Vehicle v)`: a car has 4, a motorcycle 2, a truck 6.
a truck pays 500, plus 100 for every **full** 1000 kg of its `capacity`.

blocks.text: Use `switch` expressions over the vehicle; with `Vehicle` sealed, neither needs a `default`.

cases.says: A car, a motorcycle and a truck report their wheels and their toll.
Vehicle is a sealed interface permitting exactly Car, Motorcycle and Truck.
A truck pays extra only for each full 1000 kg of capacity.

concepts: An interface can be sealed too, and records, being implicitly final, are ready-made permitted implementations.
